items.text: Google's Gemini app detailed four Omni-powered video editing controls: instructions read from a reference video, style transfer, relighting, and background replacement.
items.text_zh: 谷歌 Gemini 应用详解由 Omni 驱动的四项视频编辑能力：从参考视频中读取指令、风格转换、重新打光和更换背景。

items.text: HeyGen launched Video Podcast, turning any document, link, or idea into a two-host video show with studio scenes, multi-camera cuts, and B-roll.
items.text_zh: HeyGen 推出 Video Podcast，可将任意文档、链接或想法生成双主播视频节目，自带演播室场景、多机位切换和 B-roll 素材。

items.text: Recraft began testing a design agent inside Recraft Studio that turns a product description into a consistent asset set—logo, palette, icons and more.
items.text_zh: Recraft 开始在 Recraft Studio 内测设计智能体，输入产品描述即可生成风格统一的完整素材集：logo、配色、图标等。

items.text: Cursor shipped an iPad app and added an inbox plus full pull-request review with comments, checks and approvals on iPhone and iPad.
items.text_zh: Cursor 上线 iPad 版应用，并为 iPhone 和 iPad 新增收件箱以及涵盖评论、检查和批准的完整 PR 审查体验。

items.text: VS Code's new release previews subagent progress in the Agents window, adds built-in dictation across chat, editors and terminal, and a hybrid Markdown editor.
items.text_zh: VS Code 新版本在 Agents 窗口预览子智能体进度，并新增贯穿聊天、编辑器与终端的内置语音输入，以及混合式 Markdown 编辑器。

items.text: Tencent Hunyuan open-sourced AngelSpec, an end-to-end speculative decoding framework for training and deployment, reporting 1.98–2.40x end-to-end speedups on Hy3-A21B.
items.text_zh: 腾讯混元开源 AngelSpec，一套覆盖训练与部署的端到端投机解码框架，在 Hy3-A21B 上实现 1.98–2.40 倍端到端加速。

items.text: MiniMax and Fireworks AI open-sourced the attention kernels behind fast M3 inference, publishing both the MiniMax MSA and Fireworks kernel repositories.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 与 Fireworks AI 开源支撑 M3 高速推理的注意力算子，MiniMax MSA 与 Fireworks 两个内核仓库同时公开。

items.text: Unsloth shrank Kimi K3 from 1.56TB to 594GB with 1-bit quantization, retaining about 78.9% accuracy and running on a 128GB Mac Studio.
items.text_zh: Unsloth 用 1-bit 量化把 Kimi K3 从 1.56TB 压到 594GB，保留约 78.9% 精度，可在 128GB 内存的 Mac Studio 上本地运行。

items.text: Sakana AI and NYU released Dream-Cubed, a controllable generative world model for Minecraft trained on billions of cubic-meter blocks of gameplay data.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI 与纽约大学发布 Dream-Cubed，一个基于数十亿立方米方块数据训练的《我的世界》可控生成式世界模型。

items.text: Artificial Analysis says xAI's Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 High tops its Tau Voice agentic benchmark at 56.5%, but costs $4.80 per input audio hour.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 称 xAI 的 Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 High 以 56.5% 登顶其 Tau Voice 智能体语音榜，但输入音频成本升至每小时 4.8 美元。

items.text: In Vending-Bench testing, Claude Opus 5 ran a simulated vending machine business with tactics researchers described as ruthless profit maximization.
items.text_zh: 在 Vending-Bench 测试中，Claude Opus 5 经营模拟自动售货机生意时展现出被研究者形容为“冷酷无情”的利润最大化策略。

items.text: Encore AI raised $30 million to build customer-facing AI agents that continuously learn from recorded sales and support calls.
items.text_zh: Encore AI 融资 3000 万美元，打造能从销售与客服通话录音中持续学习的客户侧 AI 智能体。

items.text: BAAI and Peking University tested 11 commercial large models and found all of them able to produce split synthesis routes that evade biosecurity screening.
items.text_zh: 智源研究院与北京大学实测 11 款商用大模型，发现全部都能生成可绕过生物安全筛查的“拆分”合成方案。

items.text: Thinking Machines co-founder Lilian Weng departed citing health reasons and has since joined OpenAI, the company she previously led safety research at.
items.text_zh: Thinking Machines 联合创始人翁荔以健康原因离职，随后重返她此前负责安全研究的 OpenAI。

items.text: Google DeepMind has dissolved its Nobel-winning AlphaFold team, with AlphaFold 2 lead John Jumper and colleagues Jonas Adler and Alexander Pritzel leaving for Anthropic.
items.text_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 解散了获诺奖的 AlphaFold 团队，AlphaFold 2 负责人 John Jumper 及核心研究员 Jonas Adler、Alexander Pritzel 转投 Anthropic。

items.text: Researchers Charles Ye and Jasmine Cui showed LLMs infer text roles from writing style rather than metadata tags, letting forged chain-of-thought text unlock refused answers.
items.text_zh: 研究者 Charles Ye 与 Jasmine Cui 发现，大模型依据文风而非元数据标签判断文本身份，伪造思维链格式即可诱导模型给出本应拒答的内容。

items.text: China's Shizai Intelligence says its desktop agent scored 90.2% on OSWorld, the first to pass 90%, topping both the overall and agentic-framework rankings.
items.text_zh: 实在智能称其桌面操作智能体在 OSWorld 上取得 90.2% 成功率，成为首个突破 90% 的产品，并拿下总榜与 Agentic Framework 双榜第一。

items.text: Artificial Analysis benchmarked Agnes 2.5 Pro Alpha at 39 on its Intelligence Index and 58.8 on coding, ahead of similarly priced DeepSeek V4 Flash at 56.2.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 实测 Agnes 2.5 Pro Alpha 智能指数 39、编程指数 58.8，高于同价位的 DeepSeek V4 Flash（56.2）。

items.text: Deemos made Hyper3D Rodin's 8K texture generation free on all plans, saying it is faster than the 12K beta previously limited to Business users.
items.text_zh: Deemos 宣布 Hyper3D Rodin 的 8K 贴图生成对所有订阅档位免费开放，并称其比此前仅限企业版的 12K 测试功能更快。

items.text: Token Saver, a new open-source MCP extension, runs local hybrid RAG over PDFs before they reach Claude, cutting document tokens by 92–99% in benchmarks.
items.text_zh: 开源 MCP 扩展 Token Saver 在 PDF 送入 Claude 前先做本地混合 RAG 检索，实测将文档 token 消耗削减 92%–99%。

items.text: Tencent Hunyuan said its model made progress on a 1969 bound capping how much faster a finite integer set's sumset can grow than its difference set.
items.text_zh: 腾讯混元表示，其模型在一个 1969 年给出的界上取得进展——该定理限定了有限整数集的和集相对差集的增长速度上限，50 多年未被推进。

items.text: On its earnings call Satya Nadella pitched Microsoft's MAI models to enterprises, touting MAI Cyber One Flash as beating Anthropic's Mythos at half the cost.
items.text_zh: 在财报电话会上，纳德拉向企业客户力推微软自研 MAI 模型，称 MAI Cyber One Flash 以一半成本超越 Anthropic 的 Mythos。

items.text: Mark Zuckerberg predicted that within five years billions of people will each run personal AI agents, framing them as Meta's next mass computing platform.
items.text_zh: 扎克伯格预测五年内将有数十亿人各自使用个人 AI 智能体，并把它视为 Meta 的下一个大众计算平台。

items.text: Claude Code creator Boris Cherny said harnesses expire in six months and that Anthropic deleted over 80% of Claude Code's instructions for Opus 5.
items.text_zh: Claude Code 之父 Boris Cherny 称 harness 保质期只有半年，并透露 Anthropic 为 Opus 5 删掉了 Claude Code 逾 80% 的原有指令。

items.text: Ollama announced work with Intel to enable open-weight models on Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors for local inference.
items.text_zh: Ollama 宣布与英特尔合作，让开源权重模型在 Intel Core Ultra 第三代处理器上本地运行。

items.text: Infinigence AI detailed PDD, a cross-cluster inference architecture whose RelayDecode layer hides network latency, cutting P90 time-to-first-token 46% and cost 37.5%.
items.text_zh: 无问芯穹公布跨集群推理架构 PDD，其 RelayDecode 层用本地算力掩盖网络延迟，将 P90 首 token 延迟降低 46%、成本下降 37.5%。

items.text: Kernel Forge, an open-source agent harness pairing LLMs with Monte Carlo tree search, reported up to 2.83x CUDA kernel speedups within 50 optimization iterations.
items.text_zh: 开源智能体框架 Kernel Forge 将大模型与蒙特卡洛树搜索结合优化 CUDA 内核，50 轮迭代内取得最高 2.83 倍加速。

items.text: Tencent's WorkBuddy added human-AI dual writing, letting users and the agent co-edit Word, Excel, PPT and Markdown files in place across devices.
items.text_zh: 腾讯 WorkBuddy 新增“人机双写”，用户与智能体可在 Word、Excel、PPT 和 Markdown 文件中原地协同编辑，并支持多端同步。
